explanation: February made the two things October used. It created the soviet, an assembly with real authority over the garrison and the railways and no responsibility for governing, which is the instrument the Bolsheviks took Petrograd with in October. It also left the Provisional Government committed to continuing the war, and that commitment emptied the government of support through the summer. The Kornilov affair in August then armed the Bolsheviks and discredited the government at once. Whether October was a revolution or a coup is argued elsewhere. This edge says only that February set the field October was played on.
